tells.1: The sympathy feels piled on ('you're not alone', 'most of us in the same boat') and the newsletter title appears late.
tells.2: It reads a bit over-polished, with a stack of cozy idioms ('kept us on our toes', 'catch your breath') and an em-dash flourish.
tells.3: The transition 'our thoughts are turning to...' is formulaic, and the close is abrupt.

reason: Version 4 is the clearest and most credible: it leads with the newsletter name, keeps the warmth without overdone idioms, and closes with a simple invitation to respond.
